import con_degen as degen

random.seed()

owner = Variable()
burn_rate = Variable()
min_amount = Variable()
max_amount = Variable()
chance_to_win = Variable()
consec_extra = Variable()

extra = Hash(default_value=0)

BURN_ADDRESS = "degen_burn_address"

@construct
def init():
    # Owner of this contract
    owner.set(ctx.caller)
    # Burn rate for lost flips in %
    burn_rate.set(50)
    # Min amount of tokens to bet
    min_amount.set(10)
    # Max amount of tokens to bet
    max_amount.set(100)
    # Change to win in %
    chance_to_win.set(45)
    # Extra payout for consecutive wins in %
    consec_extra.set(10)

@export
def flip(amount: float):
    error = "Amount must be equal to or greater than " + str(min_amount.get())
    assert amount >= min_amount.get(), error

    error = "Amount must be equal to or less than " + str(max_amount.get())
    assert amount <= max_amount.get(), error

    balances = ForeignHash(foreign_contract='con_degen', foreign_name='balances')
    
    win_amount = (amount * 2) + (amount / 100 * extra[ctx.caller])
    
    error = "Contract does not have enough balance to pay for possible"
    assert balances[ctx.this] >= win_amount, error

    degen.transfer_from(
        amount=amount,
        to=ctx.this,
        main_account=ctx.caller)

    if random.randint(1, 100) <= chance_to_win.get():
        degen.transfer(amount=win_amount, to=ctx.caller)

        extra[ctx.caller] += consec_extra.get()

        return f"{win_amount}"

    else:
        burn_amount = amount / 100 * burn_rate.get()
        degen.transfer(amount=burn_amount, to=BURN_ADDRESS)

        extra[ctx.caller] = 0

        return "'0'"

@export
def set_consecutive_extra(percent: float):
    error = "Only owner can adjust consecutive extra rate"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error

    error = "Wrong consecutive extra value"
    assert (percent >= 0 and percent <= 100), error

    consec_extra.set(percent)

@export
def set_chance_to_win(percent: float):
    error = "Only owner can adjust chance to win"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error

    error = "Wrong chance to win value"
    assert (percent >= 0 and percent <= 100), error

    chance_to_win.set(percent)

@export
def set_burn(percent: float):
    error = "Only owner can adjust burn rate"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error

    error = "Wrong burn rate value"
    assert (percent >= 0 and percent <= 100), error

    burn_rate.set(percent)

@export
def set_min(amount: int):
    error = "Only owner can adjust min amount"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error

    min_amount.set(amount)

@export
def set_max(amount: int):
    error = "Only owner can adjust max amount"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error

    max_amount.set(amount)

@export
def pay_in(amount: float):
    degen.transfer_from(amount=amount, to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller)

@export
def pay_out(amount: float):
    error = "Only owner can payout tokens"
    assert ctx.caller == owner.get(), error
    degen.transfer(amount=amount, to=ctx.caller)
